purpose: P0 lifecycle regression contract; planned requirements are not passing evidence
oracles: Exact ordered or explicitly normalized page identity sets before quit, after process exit, and after next-process stabilization
Independent original and saved byte expectations including encoding, BOM, newline and resources
Durable generic recovery plus Rust review identity, generation and decisions
Actual committed session CAS response and process disappearance, not an IPC send alone
Final source, index, boot, executable and archive digests bound to each result

cases.input: Nonempty saved session; Finder opens one or five files before restore completes
cases.expected: All old and new pages preserved in order; no deadlock; subsequent close remains write-eligible
cases.required: deterministic interleaving + real Mac host + restart

cases.input: Initial launch file and later queued OS file
cases.expected: Restore's own open does not wait behind external opens; last explicit target is correct

cases.input: Unchanged saved file; LF, CRLF, CR, BOM, UTF-16 and empty body
cases.expected: Open/edit is clean; close needs no save confirmation; original bytes unchanged
Exact visible draft, target and edit mode remain; later Save or Discard can complete
cases.required: native input + durable draft + subsequent decision

cases.input: Manual edit then Do not save
cases.expected: Saved preview restored, original bytes untouched, discarded body recoverable, next tab close succeeds
cases.required: native decision + actual history read + byte oracle

cases.input: Repeated close/edit-exit/quit while one confirmation is open
cases.expected: One decision owner; handlers are not replaced; every request settles; no hidden stale focus timer

cases.input: Active/inactive, first/last, other/all tab close; buttons, keyboard and menus; background Save with failed activation
cases.expected: Only explicitly selected identities removed after ACK; cancellation preserves other pages; failed activation never saves the currently visible unrelated page
cases.required: real session + failed review flush + fixed save target + bounded trigger categories + restart

cases.input: AI/manual edit, undo-to-same-text or document switch while decision/save is pending
cases.expected: Generation and fixed target prevent losing newer input or mutating a different document

cases.input: Clean restored file returns 404, 409, 503 or transport failure
cases.expected: Explicit unavailable page retained; Retry or explicit Close; never create/save/export an invented empty document
cases.required: controlled failures + real 404 + retry after file becomes available + restart

cases.input: Dirty descriptor but required draft/review original cannot be read
cases.expected: Authoritative descriptor and necessary originals retained; no clean conversion or destructive session rewrite; actionable recovery
cases.required: fault injection + new-process recovery; remains pending until independently proven

cases.input: Read/retry/export finishes after switching or closing its page
cases.expected: Old result discarded; closed page cannot reappear; no previous page displayed under a new title

cases.input: External file change, identity replacement, locked target or controlled ENOSPC
cases.expected: No overwrite of unknown object; failed save/close retains live text and recovery; explicit retry available
cases.required: real service/files + controlled faults, separate from true power loss

cases.input: Lost session ACK, competing process, invalid receipt or write failure
cases.expected: Exact idempotent request retained; no refresh-to-latest overwrite; no premature UI removal

cases.input: Window red button, tray residency, real Quit, empty and nonempty sessions
cases.expected: Hide and true exit distinguished; jobs follow their specified lifetime; closed tabs stay closed and remaining pages restore
cases.required: native OS controls + process exit + next process

cases.input: Same-version overlay installation with an existing WebKit profile and cached script/style URLs
cases.expected: Changed assets have content-bound revisions; final installed app loads new behavior; defaults, settings and documents preserved
cases.required: warm profile + package extracted from public release + digest check

cases.input: Narrow/high-DPI/RTL windows and changed language on an unavailable page
cases.expected: Clear loading/failure/retry states, single-line toolbar, usable 44px targets and translated dynamic feedback
cases.required: 1024x680 + 1160x820 + available high DPI + keyboard/IME + semantic language review

executionRules: Single owner of native desktop input; do not disturb another conversation's models or tasks
Preserve first failure and classify environment, missing input and product defects separately
Use production CSP and actual authentication; no test-token or chooser substitutes
Never edit pinned-source hashes or protected bytes to hide a regression
Do not publish original user paths, content, credentials or screenshots; use dedicated fixed inputs
Mac ARM native, Intel via Rosetta, physical Intel, Windows and Linux remain distinct evidence scopes
